summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (40 tests) under the prepared venv. Nothing is committed. Not verified: black, isort, and mypy are not installed in the venv, so formatting and type checks were done by hand only.
